notes.title: "Hamster Playground" Full Release is Here!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello Hamster Enthusiasts![/h1][/b]

[b]The day we've all been waiting for has finally arrived![/b]  We are beyond excited to announce that "Hamster Playground" is now officially out of Early Access and fully released on Steam still as a FREE-TO-PLAY game! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182513/003751a50d126af33f85c3309d98a92117efdccc.png[/img]
[h2]
[b]About the Game:[/b][/h2]
"Hamster Playground" invites you into a whimsical world where you can care for, train, and style your adorable hamsters. Set in a beautifully designed Hamster House, you can customize each room to your heart's content and compete in a variety of fun mini-games with other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182513/b490049766b85b8907aac6265822902b84fefcda.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]New Features in Version 1.0:
[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Decorate Your Hamster House: Furnish and decorate your Hamster House with new items, creating a perfect home for your furry friends.
[*] Exciting Mini-Games: Test your skills in mini-games like "Beware the Cat", "Vehicle Pull", "Skateboard Racing", and "Eating Contest" - Challenge your friends and players worldwide in these thrilling activities.
[*] Train and Nurture: Develop your hamsters' abilities and skills to compete at higher levels and ensure they are always happy and healthy.
[*] Customize Your Hamsters: Style your hamsters with a variety of outfits and accessories. Make each hamster unique with over 100 cosmetic items available.
[/list]

[b][h2]Special Announcement for Early Access Players:[/h2][/b]
As a token of our appreciation, all players who downloaded "Hamster Playground" during the Early Access phase will receive the[b]"Ancient Skin Pack", "Eating Contest" [/b]and [b]"Skateboard Racing"[/b] game modes for [b]FREE! [/b][b]Thank you for your support and for being part of our journey from the beginning.[/b]

[h2]DLCs Available Now:[/h2]
In addition to the base game, we have several exciting DLCs available for purchase to spice up your hamster's life. Explore themed packs and items like the Ancient Pack, Conquerors Pack, and various themed house decor packs, as well as virtual currency (Diamonds) to buy additional cosmetics and in-game items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182513/f3354f53648b5e5da6f43e6d28c92ed7399fbf71.jpg[/img]

[b]What are you waiting for? [/b]Dive into the enchanting world of "Hamster Playground" today! Download it for free on Steam and start building your perfect hamster paradise. Compete in mini-games, decorate your Hamster House, and show off your stylish hamsters to the world. We can't wait to see you in the game!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442670/Hamster_Playground/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442670/Hamster_Playground/
[/url]

Thank you all for your incredible support. Let's make "Hamster Playground" the best hamster experience ever!

Happy Hamstering,
The We Dig Games Team

notes.title: Hamster Playground is leaving Early Access.
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there - it's been a while! [/h2]

[h3]You probably thought we abandoned our little, cozy game, right? [/h3]
The thing is, that we didn't. We worked hard to update and upgrade Hamster Playground after the release all this time ago. 
So now, the time has finally come, and we can proudly reveal, that the game will leave Early Access next month! 

[h3]We can even share the exact date: 11.07.2024[/h3]

We have some important information, regarding leaving Early Access, so please - check all the information below, but first - check out the newest trailer we created for this reveal. 

[previewyoutube=lv3QZHsCBBg;full][/previewyoutube]

Right, now it is time for a few important news about Hamster Playground. 

[list]
[*]The game will remain [b]free for everyone[/b]. This will not change. 
[*]There will be paid DLCs, skin packs, and game modes. 
[*]Diamonds (our in-game currency) will also remain and will be available for purchase to buy some special, and premium cosmetics in the game. 
[*]Everyone who added the game to their library during the EA will be granted a gift from us: you will have [b]2 game modes[/b] ([i]Skateboard Game Mode[/i], and [i]Eating Contest Game Mode[/i]) and [i]Ancient Skin Pack[/i] [b]available for free[/b] in the game. 
[/list]

We hope you are as excited about the launch as we are, and you all will revisit the Hamster House, once it is fully released! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182513/0b627c037ffd8571db3b133e590a44ebc494b242.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update on 'Hamster Playground': Progress and Exciting Developments
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182513/6931382054497a649953ba3004ee6dc842559cd7.png[/img]

Dear Hamster Playground Community,

[b]We want to extend our heartfelt appreciation for your support and enthusiasm for our game.[/b] While we understand that you've been eagerly awaiting updates, we wanted to take a moment to provide you with some insights into our current status.


As much as we wish we could bring you constant news of progress, we've encountered a few technical challenges and optimization hurdles along the way. [b]Please accept our sincerest apologies for any delays this may have caused.[/b] We're committed to delivering an great gaming experience, and this requires us to work diligently behind the scenes.

But rest assured, these periods of silence do not mean we've been idle. Quite the contrary. Our team has been hard at work crafting exciting new content and refining additional mechanics that will elevate the "Hamster Playground" experience to new heights. Remember that we're a very small team of developers and we've taken this idea of a game in a very ambitious way. 

Furthermore, we are happy to share that we are simultaneously working on bringing "Hamster Playground" to console versions, the same way as on PC - in Free to Play -  ensuring that everyone can enjoy the game on their preferred platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182513/b09edce47c7a4017460a0abe7088d30e7a68470e.png[/img]

We understand that patience can sometimes wear thin, and we're incredibly grateful for your understanding as we navigate these challenges. Your support fuels our determination to create a game that exceeds your expectations.

On that note, we're excited to announce that if all goes well, [b]we're planning to leave Early Access early next year. [/b]This milestone represents a significant step towards bringing you the polished and delightful "Hamster Playground" we've all been eagerly anticipating.

Once again, we thank you for your continued patience, passion, and belief in our vision.
 [b]Your feedback and enthusiasm continue to inspire us, and we can't wait to share more exciting news with you soon.[/b]

Thank you,
The WeDigGames Team

[*] Minor economy changes - mostly race awards re-balancing
[*] Minor bug fixes all around the place
[/list]

notes.title: Hamster Playground is now available!
notes.content:
Hello, all you beautiful people! 

We are thrilled to announce, that Hamster Playground is [b]now available[/b] in Early Access [b]for free[/b]! 

The build available on Steam right now allows you to experience the full gameplay loop – players will begin by acquiring their first hamster and having a look around the default, basic hamster house. What happens next is up to them – they can take a deep dive into racing in the maze, skateboard drag races, or eating contest; race online against other players, spend hours customizing their pet and the house, upgrade equipment, and expand their rooster by unlocking new hamster slots.

We are hoping to hear your thoughts and ideas, as we will work on finishing the game. All feedback and suggestions are welcome, and the best way to talk to us is at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1442670/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/CnA6M3M]Discord[/url]! 

[u][b]HAVE FUN! [/b][/u]
We Dig Games Team

P.S.
Here is a brand new trailer! Enjoy!
